entities.name: Miro Barešić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miro Barešić was a Croatian émigré and terrorist who, in 1971, murdered Yugoslav diplomat Vladimir Rolović in Sweden. He later served as a soldier in Paraguay and in the Croatian National Guard in 1991.

entities.summary: Miro Barešić was a Croatian émigré and terrorist who, in 1971, murdered Yugoslav diplomat Vladimir Rolović in Sweden. He later served as a soldier in Paraguay and in the Croatian National Guard in 1991.
